notes.title: Outer Gas featured in Games Forged in Germany
notes.content:
[p][b]Hey everyone – welcome to our second Outer Gas Devlog![/b]
We’re super excited to be part of the [b]Games Forged in Germany[/b] Steam event this weekend! 🎉[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45570126/c68f92fe0828b5302e15b1f6385446e5d050f9e7.png"][/img][/p][p]To celebrate, we put together a little trailer to show off some of the core features we’ve been working on in Outer Gas. Lately, we’ve been focusing on getting the basics in place: especially the [b]oil rig and turret area[/b] on the planet underneath your gas station.[/p][p]We also made some nice progress on the [b]pumping mechanic[/b], and the gas station itself is starting to feel a bit more alive with [b]stocked-up shelves[/b] and a few visual upgrades.[/p][p]Behind the scenes, we’ve also been busy [b]designing the management systems[/b], both for running the shop and keeping the oil rigs below running smoothly. There’s a lot of planning and balancing involved, and we’re excited to share more about that soon.[/p][p]Of course, there’s still [b]lots of work ahead[/b], but we’re making steady progress! We’ll be posting regular updates, so if you want to stay in the loop, [b]make sure to join our community group[/b] right here on Steam.[/p][p]Thanks for being here, and stay tuned for more Outer Gas goodness![/p]

notes.title: Outer Gas Devlog #1
notes.content:
[b]Hey everyone![/b]

We’re the two-man indie team working on Outer Gas — a quirky little gas station simulator set in space. We’re super excited to finally bring this idea to life! If you want to follow the development and get updates whenever something new drops, don’t forget to wishlist Outer Gas and join our community group.
[b]
So, what’s this all about?[/b]
Outer Gas has been in the back of our minds for a while, but it only recently started to take shape. Right now, we’re building the game from the ground up — working on the core design systems and visual style. You can already get a small glimpse of the concept in some early screenshots, and we’ll be sharing more in the coming weeks, including actual gameplay video footage. 

We’ve already got plenty of ideas on how to make the game fun and challenging, but we’d love to also hear from you:
[b]What kind of mechanics would you like to see in the game?[/b]

Thanks for being part of the journey!

Cheers,
Brotlose Kunst
